March 3, 2025

Dear Marcus Delgado,

Congratulations! This letter confirms our offer of a Headlamp Fellowship
through the DoD SkillBridge program, beginning June 2, 2025 and ending
approximately August 22, 2025 with duty at Ironvale Energy Services.
They are located at 4100 Range Road, Odessa, TX 79762.

Your initial direct supervisor will be Dana Whitfield, Director of Field
Operations at Ironvale Energy Services.

Your role will be a Wind Turbine Technician Fellow.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Assist with scheduled preventive maintenance on turbine drivetrains
- Document inspection findings in the maintenance tracking system
- Support lockout/tagout procedures under direct supervision
- Participate in daily safety briefings and toolbox talks

Ironvale Energy Services intends to extend their own offer of employment
to strong performers at the conclusion of the fellowship.

We are excited to have you aboard.

Sincerely,

Signed by: Avery Coleman, Program Director, Headlamp
